declared_by: student (product judgment), 2026-10-20, after reading the memo-v4 output
rule: Ads and Premium-only features are how the free tier earns revenue. Complaints about them are complaints about the business model, not defects: removing the cause would cost revenue. Work on them should make them less disruptive within the business model (e.g. ad frequency, timing, loudness, relevance), not remove them. Defects (crashes, playback stops, sign-in failures) carry no such trade-off.
